_about: Longshore sandbars by area (area.py _bars): each beach's crest distances from the waterline (m) found from Sentinel-2 L2A calm days' water colour, 2023-26 scenes, profiles every 50 m along ~3.6 km round 'at' (lat, lon); only crests within 400 m and seen on half the profiles or more. Crest depths are a rule, not measured: the first bar 1.2 m, the second 2.2 m below mean sea level. 'clear': circles (lat, lon, metres) kept free, a harbour's mouth whose moles aren't in the breakwater tiles. The owner, 20.11.2026: 'build B,C,D,E', then 'Yes, add the bars'.

lielupes-ieteka.note: Shoals (20.11.2026) from Sentinel-2's calm colour over the mouth, the median of many scenes, contoured as depth caps; river channels and vegetation uncapped. Scale set by the owner's "Depth there knee deep in lielupe usually" (the riding area's median 0.50 m); the 1.0 m cap left out: the satellite sees ~1.5 m here, unverified.

gauja.note: Shoals (20.11.2026) from Sentinel-2's calm colour over the mouth, the median of many scenes, contoured as depth caps; river channels and vegetation uncapped. Its own scale; the riding area's median 1.08 m, the owner's "Waist deep" (an independent check).

berzciems.note: The owner's outlines (20.11.2026: "i marked all sandbars and behind it lagoons"; then "my marked region not exact region of sandbanks. I marked area where they are only"): inside them the banks from Sentinel-2's calm colour, scaled on the brightest sand as +0.25 m ("Usually bank appears at 20-30cm water level") and the outside water as 2.4 m (the lagoon, darker than deep water behind the bar, can't anchor it), contoured at -0.25 (from the unsmoothed depths, water there 30 % of scenes or more) / 0.1 / 0.3 / 0.6 m; the lagoons 0.12 m. Reeds and stones left out.
